supplementalAdjudication: The three E04 completion scores rise from 2 to 4 only after the supplemental current HTTP Memory and source-lineage readback. The immutable old snapshot hash matches after normalizing only its legitimate published-to-superseded lifecycle status and using the HTTP schema serializer. Original artifacts and earlier scores remain preserved.
limitations: No Web/iOS rendered screenshot or interaction review is included; naturalness scores cover the visible product draft/question text only.

The original fourth attempt did not capture full before-evidence rows (beforeEvidenceAvailable=false). The supplement proves original snapshot content, original evidence identity, current active/reviewed scoped source and current Memory dependency; it does not prove a complete row-by-row metadata history.
E04 recovery covers the observed tool-order error only; no other recovery or deletion scenario is implied.
The 292049 ms E02 trial remains an observed latency concern; no performance threshold was invented or failures discarded.
This review does not replace earlier failed runner attempts and does not establish complete GET-9 acceptance.
reviewOutcome: E02 and E04 each pass quality for all three fourth-attempt trials within the stated evidence scope.
